data.name: Semantic nearest-neighbour baseline
data.research_question: How does a simple semantic nearest-neighbour distance compare with the autoencoder?
data.hypothesis: Cosine distance to the nearest benign training embedding will provide a strong, interpretable baseline.
data.training_strategy: Store benign training embeddings; no parametric training.
data.interpretation: Planned comparison to test whether the autoencoder adds value beyond embedding similarity.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
